value.rationale: A recently published scalable stability diagnostic assumes the principal eigenvalue lies in the hub row disc. This result supplies sharp, graph-uniform necessary and sufficient boundaries for failure and an arbitrarily small false-safe hub radius for fixed networks, and unbounded spectral-versus-hub-disc discrepancy across growing stars; every eligible graph is covered. The exact star ownership crossover makes the boundary quantitatively interpretable, rather than an isolated numeric discrepancy.
